Equipment
 Mixed bed caustic dosing PUMP

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be 
 performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title block.

This pump is used to transfer the sewage water from the collection tank to 
 the Aeration tank .

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawe, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by eng Saeed Sowan , accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality 
 control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb 
 inspection & quality control's head sector.

rows: Mixed Bed Exchanger Caustic Dosing Pump
XL50 MA 140 DV FA Z92 M3052

Hydraulic diaphragm positive return metering pump with 
 fixed stroke length , worm reduction unit enclosed in an oil 
 splash-lubricated painted cast iron casing, built in relief valve , air 
 bleed valve and mechanically actuated oil replenishing

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor

Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction values

Be sure pump must be completely 
 drained
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller
Checks pump capacity, pressure and power.
Check the noisy of the Pump
Check the level of diaphragm oil.
Check the level of oil in gear box.
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Adjust mechanical seal leakage

Check the pump and piping flanges for leaks and re-tighten if 
 needed.
Check the bolts fixation

Before starting the pump, the following steps 
should be checked

items: Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting.

The level of liquid in the tank must be above the minimum 
 level

The on off valve in the suction from the tank ,must be 
 completely open, while the air discharge valve after complete priming if 
 applicable-and the draining valve must be closed.

The control valve in delivery to the pump , must be 
 partially-but never completely closed

Attendance and checking during operation of 
the pump, the following should be checked:

items: Check of flow rate , delivery head and absorbed power

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be 
 performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title block.
This pump is used to transfer the sewage water from the collection tank to 
 the Aeration tank .
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawe, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by eng Saeed Sowan , accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality 
 control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb 
 inspection & quality control's head sector.

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction values
Be sure pump must be completely 
 drained
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in operation
Checks pump capacity, pressure and power.
Check the noisy of the Pump
Check the level of diaphragm oil.
Check the level of oil in gear box.
Pump out of operation
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Adjust mechanical seal leakage
Check the pump and piping flanges for leaks and re-tighten if 
 needed.
Check the bolts fixation
Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the following steps 
should be checked
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting.
The level of liquid in the tank must be above the minimum 
 level
The on off valve in the suction from the tank ,must be 
 completely open, while the air discharge valve after complete priming if 
 applicable-and the draining valve must be closed.
The control valve in delivery to the pump , must be 
 partially-but never completely closed
Attendance and checking during operation of 
the pump, the following should be checked:
Check of flow rate , delivery head and absorbed power
